overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board substantially complied with the minutes requirement for the March 9 and April 13, 2011 meetings, though it urged recording dissenting views.

allegations.summary: Complainants said the March 9, 2011 hearing minutes omitted their proposed corrections to Items 13 and 14, so the summary of discussion was inadequate.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Board substantially complied with the requirement that it provide an accurate and sufficiently detailed summary of the discussion that occurred.

allegations.summary: Complainants said the April 13, 2011 minutes of Item 6 omitted about 30 minutes of discussion between the Chair and a member about a letter, so the minutes were inaccurate.
allegations.key_passage: The minutes do not cover every remark or opinion presented at the meeting, but the Board included the minimum that the law requires.
